subject: Monday 8am — WC-12 field (third item behind 4B-12 and the printer)
body:
Hi — I'm covering this floor queue: Raj's monitor at 4B-12, Lisa's printer on 3, and the last open item is the new-hire packet WC-12.

She arrives 8am Monday and can't get on Northwind-Employee until the packet closes. The close is a reply to this email (huynp2@illinois.edu) carrying the employee Wi-Fi password for Northwind-Employee, exactly as it is stored — the scanner matches it byte-for-byte and a generic note won't clear it.

If it's not in tonight she's turned away at the lobby. Please reply with it before end of day.

Thanks,
H. Pham
